Name: Marina Di Valletta
HQ Location: Malta, Tal-pietà, Triq Sa Maison Haywharf
Company description: Marina di Valletta offers state-of-the-art marina amenities, which include controlled access parking dedicated to owners, round the clock berthing assistance, 24hr security and a marina office offering conveniences and concierge services. The Marina boasts a luxury environment with high-end finishes installed throughout the concession area. Pontoons are wider than the average width of local marinas offering better stability and comfort for marina patrons and will cater for up to 274 Berths from 10metre to 28metre. Dedicated and shared berths are available for transit yachts up to 24m, as well as an outer arm of the 120m breakwater to welcome Superyachts up to 50metres in length or 500GT in transit. Transit yacht owners shall, for the first time, have direct access to Valletta and City Gate within walking distance and the company is looking at the possibility of establishing a direct transport link to the capital for marina patrons.

Name: Domus Zamittello
Company description: Domus Zamittello is a restored 17th century palazzo tastefully converted into a 21-room and suite boutique hotel. The hotel is ideally located at the beginning of Republic Street just as one enters the cultural capital city of Valletta. Domus Zamittello invites guests to enjoy the vibrant and cultural baroque capital along with its high-end shopping addresses whilst appreciating the architectural beauty of this prestigious building. The hotel offers accommodation in different elegantly designed classic rooms, some overlooking the hotel courtyard whilst those on South Street overlook the open theatre. This singular Valletta property also includes two meeting rooms offering natural light and a unique historical environment for all types of events. Domus Zamittello offers all the services to make your stay memorable, including 24 hrs reception and reservation services, transport arrangements, and concierge services. The hotel is a smoking free environment.
